entity.remarks: Shipping sanctions: where shipping sanctions apply, a specified ship is prohibited from entering a port in the UK, may be given a movement or a port entry direction, can be detained, and will be refused permission to register on the UK Ship Register or have its existing registration terminated. Trade sanctions: Provision of services relating to specified ships; Where a ship is specified for the purposes of all of the following trade prohibitions, a person must not directly or indirectly provide to that ship: technical assistance; crew services; operating services; chartering services; brokering services; financial services or funds. A person must also not directly or indirectly provide services relating to the acquisition, sale, transfer or supply of a specified ship. Procurement of services relating to specified ships: A person must not directly or indirectly procure services relating to a specified ship. For the purposes of this regulation, services relating to a specified ship include, in particular, services involving the use of that specified ship. Prohibition on chartering or operating specified ships: A person must not charter a specified ship, if the person knows, or has reasonable cause to suspect, that the ship is a specified ship. A person must not operate a specified ship, if the person knows, or has reasonable cause to suspect, that the ship is a specified ship. The above trade prohibitions may be subject to Part 7 of the Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026 (Exceptions and licences).
